title: Owned FastAPI backend foundation
intent: Provide a secure, reproducible backend foundation and root verification contract for later chat, RAG and bot stages.

requirements.title: Backend foundation and auth
requirements.description: Create FastAPI settings, database/session/migrations, cookie JWT auth, roles, seed, Compose and deterministic backend verification with a stable domain-router seam.

constraints: Cookie state changes require CSRF/origin checks.
Course CI and deploy files remain untouched.
Later domain stages consume the app/router seam and do not rewrite its ownership.
